description: List the pitches, courts and halls a BOOKABLE VENUE hires out by the hour or session (search_venues shows takesBookableSpaces: true for these). Each space has its price per hour or session, capacity, and bookingMode: "instant" (the person pays and the time is theirs at once) or "request" (the venue accepts first, then the person pays). Use check_space_availability for the free times and book_space to book.
name: list_spaces
title: List a venue's bookable spaces
